Hierarchies of strata

Source: R/hierarchy.R
mt_hierarchy.Rd

Describes how strata add up, for example women and men to both sexes, regions to the country and deprivation quintiles to all quintiles. Several variables give a crossed (grouped) structure: with sex, region and quintile every combination of a level or a total is a node, from the bottom series (one sex, one region, one quintile) to the national total for both sexes. Intermediate groups of levels, such as federal states grouped into East and West, are given with groups.

Usage

mt_hierarchy(..., additive = c("deaths", "rates"))

Arguments

...

One argument per aggregated stratum variable: the label of its total level (for example region = "Germany"), or a list with total, optionally groups (a named list of intermediate groups, each a vector of bottom levels) and additive.

additive

Default additivity of the variables: "deaths" or "rates".

Value

An object of class mt_hierarchy.

Details

Deaths add up over every hierarchy variable. Exposures add up over variables that divide the population (sex, regions, deprivation quintiles: additive = "deaths", the default) and are shared by the levels of variables that do not (causes of death: additive = "rates", whose rates add up to the all-cause rate). Variables of both kinds can be crossed, for example regions and causes: deaths are summed over both, exposures over regions only, and forecasts are reconciled on the deaths scale with these exposures.

See also

mt_aggregate_strata(), mt_validate(), mt_reconcile(), reconciled().

Examples

h <- mt_hierarchy(sex = "both", region = list(total = "DE", groups = list(East = c("BE", "SN"))),
                  quintile = "all")
h
#> <mt_hierarchy>
#>   sex: total "both"; deaths and exposures add up
#>   region: total "DE"; groups East; deaths and exposures add up
#>   quintile: total "all"; deaths and exposures add up
# regions crossed with causes of death, which share the exposure
mt_hierarchy(region = "DE", cause = list(total = "all", additive = "rates"))
#> <mt_hierarchy>
#>   region: total "DE"; deaths and exposures add up
#>   cause: total "all"; deaths add up, exposures are shared
